scenarios.title: Exercise owned capability safety
plannedActions: ScrivSession.launch(app,{persistent:true}); capabilities verifies protocol, driver, isolation object, workspace flags, UUID identities, root suffix, unique command list and declared supported/absent commands.
Select Script; key command-s; wait for saved YAM MAN sentinel. import-json exact one-direction fixture from witness lines 55-61; read persisted-projects and loaded-project.
Compare every fixture field, allowing only generated UUID and finite createdAt/modifiedAt; packages exactly [sample,current], loaded project exact, presented-alerts empty.

For install-token, authorize-origin, outbox-write, resume, reset and delete-workspace send target workspace-tabs and require exact Unknown command response. These are deliberately unsupported commands, not credential/network/outbox calls.
After EACH refusal compare entire sorted packages, full loaded-project including dates, and presented-alerts=[].
Reject activate without target and with absent target; select indices -1, segment count and string 0; text on noneditor workspace-tabs; key without modifiers. Require each exact error and invariant.
Reject extra path parameter on loaded-project, local-image-evidence, script-interaction-counts and presented-alerts; exact error and invariant after each.
import-json valid current project JSON padded to exactly 65,537 ASCII bytes (under 1 MiB transport); assert JSON parses identically, exact refusal and full unchanged invariant.
Reject relaunch({root:session.root}); require full capabilities unchanged, package/model/alert invariant and same selected tab.
Repeat twice: previous=session; session=await previous.relaunch(); capabilities asserts persistent/resumed, same root/run and new never-seen session UUID.
Read packages before Save; use Projects UI openProject(current), with public search text and Open project activation; compare full expectedLoaded and package/alert invariant.

Reject previous.command(snapshot) with Session is closing or relaunching and previous.relaunch with exact live persistent requirement; verify new session invariant after both refusals. Require three unique session IDs.
Close owner, launch default nonpersistent app, assert new root/run with sessionID=runID and same advertised isolation.
Select Script, Save fresh sample, observe exactly that one package and distinct sample IDs.
Reject fresh.relaunch; assert package and loaded model unchanged, no alerts; require exact four completed chapters; finally close owned sessions without deleting data.
expectedOutcomes: Fresh persistent capability contract has expected identities and advertised policy, and saved fixture matches independent input.
Independent fixture and unchanged package/model/alert invariants.
Every invalid public request receives exact error followed by full nonmutation assertions.
Argument-bearing relaunch retains full capability and selected tab.
Two process rotations preserve root/run and exact saved/loaded document while old sessions refuse use.
New root contains only new saved sample; nonpersistent relaunch rejection is nonmutating.
